def PPCM():
    x = p.t1.text()
    y = p.t2.text()
    if verif(x) and verif(y):
        a = abs(int(x))
        b = abs(int(y))
        if a != 0 and b != 0:
            sa = a
            sb = b
            while (sa != sb):
                if sa < sb:
                    sa += a
                else:
                    sb += b

            p.t3.setText(str(sa))
        else:
            p.t3.setText('Pas de PPCM')
    else:
        p.t3.setText('erreur')

app = QtWidgets.QApplication([])
p = uic.loadUi("calculatrice.ui")
p.show()
p.pb1.clicked.connect(Somme)
